recalls.summary: General Motors LLC (GM) is recalling certain model year 2015 Buick LaCrosse, Cadillac XTS, Chevrolet Camaro, Equinox, Malibu, and GMC Terrain vehicles.  The affected vehicles have front seat-mounted side impact air bags whose inflator may rupture upon its deployment.

General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2014-2015 Chevrolet Equinox and GMC Terrain vehicles.  The ball joints in the windshield wiper module may corrode, causing one or both windshield wipers to fail.

source: NHTSA (api.nhtsa.gov) — complaints and recalls by vehicle
